### Sicurezza digitale e tutela dei consumatori

Groups: 3 · Skills: 11

[digitalAndConsumerSafety.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/digitalAndConsumerSafety/digitalAndConsumerSafety.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Online environments expose people to privacy breaches, coercion, deception, and financial or personal exploitation. Computer security mechanisms belong primarily to Informatics; this domain concerns a person's protective decisions and recourse.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come proteggere le informazioni personali e reagire ai comportamenti ingannevoli online.

#### Frodi e pressioni ingannevoli

Skills: 4

[fraudAndDeceptivePressure.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/digitalAndConsumerSafety/fraudAndDeceptivePressure/fraudAndDeceptivePressure.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Scams often combine impersonation, urgency, emotional leverage, and requests for information or money; persuasive framing is not proof of legitimacy.

**User-friendly description (it):** Impara a riconoscere le truffe basate su false identità, urgenza e pressioni economiche.

##### Riconoscere gli schemi delle frodi finanziarie

[recognizeFinancialFraudPatterns.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/digitalAndConsumerSafety/fraudAndDeceptivePressure/skills/recognizeFinancialFraudPatterns.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify advance-fee demands, fake prizes, fraudulent marketplaces, and requests to transfer funds outside trusted channels.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci falsi premi, richieste di pagamento e offerte di vendita fraudolente.

##### Riconoscere phishing e furto d'identità

[recognizePhishingAndImpersonation.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/digitalAndConsumerSafety/fraudAndDeceptivePressure/skills/recognizePhishingAndImpersonation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Inspect suspicious messages, sender claims, and links rather than trusting apparent identity or familiar branding.

**User-friendly description (it):** Verifica collegamenti e messaggi sospetti invece di fidarti del loro aspetto.

##### Resistere alle offerte manipolatorie

[resistManipulativeOffers.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/digitalAndConsumerSafety/fraudAndDeceptivePressure/skills/resistManipulativeOffers.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** When pressured by an urgent, secretive or fear-based offer, pause the requested action, decline unsafe disclosure or payment, seek independent verification through a known channel and disengage if the pressure continues.

**User-friendly description (it):** Fermati e verifica in modo indipendente le offerte che richiedono un'azione urgente.

##### Reagire a una sospetta frode

[respondAfterSuspectedFraud.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/digitalAndConsumerSafety/fraudAndDeceptivePressure/skills/respondAfterSuspectedFraud.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Stop further interaction, secure affected access, preserve relevant evidence safely, and contact appropriate providers or authorities.

**User-friendly description (it):** Proteggi i tuoi account e cerca aiuto adeguato se sospetti una frode.

### Emergenze e protezione civile

Groups: 4 · Skills: 16

[emergenciesAndCivilProtection.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/emergenciesAndCivilProtection/emergenciesAndCivilProtection.data.ts)

Local regulations and emergency numbers belong to contextual lessons, not permanent country-specific Skill identities.

#### Pericoli legati ai conflitti

Skills: 5

[conflictRelatedDangers.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/emergenciesAndCivilProtection/conflictRelatedDangers/conflictRelatedDangers.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Armed conflict can produce immediate threats and leave dangerous remnants; civil protection centres on avoidance, shelter, and reporting rather than handling weapons.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci che ordigni sconosciuti e dispositivi abbandonati possono essere mortali.

##### Riconoscere i pericoli negli edifici danneggiati

**User-friendly description (it):** Evita edifici instabili e infrastrutture pericolose dopo un danneggiamento.

**User-friendly description (it):** Mantieniti a distanza dagli oggetti sospetti che potrebbero esplodere e segnalali in sicurezza.

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the need for immediate protection if an explosion, gunfire or other attack occurs without warning; seek the safest available cover or shelter and follow verified local civil-protection guidance when feasible.

**User-friendly description (it):** Cerca immediatamente riparo o protezione se un attacco inizia senza preavviso.

[shelterDuringImmediateDanger.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/emergenciesAndCivilProtection/evacuationAndShelter/skills/shelterDuringImmediateDanger.data.ts)

### Sicurezza quotidiana e sul lavoro

Groups: 5 · Skills: 19

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize unwanted invitations, requests for secrecy, pressure to leave a safe location or other suspicious approaches; maintain distance, decline unsafe requests and seek support from an appropriate trusted person or service.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci inviti non sicuri e chiedi un aiuto adeguato.

##### Chiedere aiuto quando ci si perde o si resta separati

[seekHelpWhenLostOrSeparated.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/everydayAndOccupationalSafety/personalSafetyInPublicPlaces/skills/seekHelpWhenLostOrSeparated.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use an appropriate safe location, identifiable helpers and reliable contact channels when separated from companions; avoid sharing unnecessary personal information or following an unverified stranger.

**User-friendly description (it):** Se ti perdi, cerca un luogo sicuro e persone affidabili a cui chiedere aiuto.

#### Strumenti e luoghi di lavoro

Skills: 3

[toolsAndWorkplaces.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/everydayAndOccupationalSafety/toolsAndWorkplaces/toolsAndWorkplaces.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Protective procedures depend on the activity, equipment, and conditions; professional work requires role-appropriate training.

**User-friendly description (it):** Impara a seguire pratiche protettive nell'uso di utensili e attrezzature.

##### Seguire procedure sicure per l'uso delle attrezzature

[followSafeEquipmentProcedures.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/everydayAndOccupationalSafety/toolsAndWorkplaces/skills/followSafeEquipmentProcedures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Respect guards, operating limits, maintenance restrictions, and stop conditions without attempting unauthorized repair.

**User-friendly description (it):** Rispetta le protezioni di sicurezza, le condizioni di arresto e i requisiti di formazione.

##### Leggere segnali e istruzioni di sicurezza

[readSafetySignsAndInstructions.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/everydayAndOccupationalSafety/toolsAndWorkplaces/skills/readSafetySignsAndInstructions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret warning symbols, restricted areas, and equipment guidance in context instead of treating a label as complete protection.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi gli avvisi sul luogo di lavoro e i limiti delle etichette di sicurezza.

##### Utilizzare dispositivi di protezione individuale

[usePersonalProtectiveEquipment.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/everydayAndOccupationalSafety/toolsAndWorkplaces/skills/usePersonalProtectiveEquipment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Match protection to the hazard and fit, recognizing that protective equipment does not eliminate the hazard.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scegli dispositivi di protezione adeguati al pericolo specifico.

### Primo soccorso e intervento immediato

Groups: 5 · Skills: 25

[firstAidAndImmediateResponse.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/firstAidAndImmediateResponse.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Immediate assistance aims to recognize danger, activate professional help, and provide appropriate basic interventions within training and scene safety. Clinical treatment and invasive procedures are not implied by inclusion in the taxonomy.

**User-friendly description (it):** Impara a riconoscere i pericoli urgenti, chiamare aiuto e prestare un'assistenza di base adeguata.

#### Supporto vitale di base

Skills: 3

[basicLifeSupport.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/basicLifeSupport/basicLifeSupport.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Resuscitation competencies require validated techniques and updated guidance appropriate to the person's age, circumstances, and responder training.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora i metodi riconosciuti di supporto vitale di base nell'ambito della formazione ricevuta.

##### Uso del defibrillatore automatico esterno

[automatedExternalDefibrillatorUse.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/basicLifeSupport/skills/automatedExternalDefibrillatorUse.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize an AED, follow its prompts, and coordinate its use with resuscitation while maintaining scene safety.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi come seguire le istruzioni di un DAE durante la rianimazione.

##### Rianimazione cardiopolmonare

[cardiopulmonaryResuscitation.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/basicLifeSupport/skills/cardiopulmonaryResuscitation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize when CPR is indicated and apply current age-appropriate basic life support principles within the responder's training.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci quando possono essere necessarie le compressioni toraciche e altre manovre di rianimazione cardiopolmonare.

##### Primo soccorso in caso di soffocamento da ostruzione

[firstAidForChoking.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/basicLifeSupport/skills/firstAidForChoking.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish effective coughing from severe airway obstruction and follow appropriate age-specific first-aid guidance rather than improvising.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci le emergenze da ostruzione delle vie aeree e gli interventi appropriati in base all'età.

#### Emorragie e lesioni

Skills: 5

[bleedingAndInjuries.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/bleedingAndInjuries/bleedingAndInjuries.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** First aid aims to prevent immediate deterioration while avoiding unnecessary manipulation or delay in definitive medical care.

**User-friendly description (it):** Impara a limitare i danni e le emorragie esterne in attesa di assistenza sanitaria professionale.

##### Prendersi cura delle ferite lievi

[careForMinorWounds.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/bleedingAndInjuries/skills/careForMinorWounds.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reduce contamination, control minor bleeding, and recognize wounds requiring professional evaluation.

**User-friendly description (it):** Pulisci e proteggi le piccole ferite e riconosci quando serve una valutazione sanitaria.

##### Controllare le emorragie esterne

[controlExternalBleeding.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/bleedingAndInjuries/skills/controlExternalBleeding.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply appropriate direct pressure and escalation when bleeding is severe, while protecting the responder from body-fluid exposure.

**User-friendly description (it):** Applica una pressione adeguata per controllare il sanguinamento proteggendo anche te stesso.

##### Immobilizzare una possibile frattura

[immobilizeSuspectedFractures.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/bleedingAndInjuries/skills/immobilizeSuspectedFractures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Limit movement and provide appropriate support without attempting to straighten a suspected fracture or dislocation.

**User-friendly description (it):** Sostieni un osso che potrebbe essere fratturato senza tentare di riallinearlo.

##### Riconoscere il pericolo di lesioni alla testa e alla colonna vertebrale

[recognizeHeadAndSpinalInjuryDanger.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/bleedingAndInjuries/skills/recognizeHeadAndSpinalInjuryDanger.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify concerning mechanisms or symptoms and avoid unnecessary movement while arranging urgent evaluation.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi perché una sospetta lesione cranica o vertebrale richiede particolare cautela nei movimenti.

##### Usare un laccio emostatico quando indicato

[useATourniquetWhenIndicated.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/bleedingAndInjuries/skills/useATourniquetWhenIndicated.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize life-threatening limb bleeding and the need for a correctly applied tourniquet according to current training and guidance.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi quando una grave emorragia a un arto può richiedere l'uso di un laccio emostatico da parte di una persona formata.

#### Lesioni acute e legate all'ambiente

Skills: 5

[environmentalAndAcuteInjuries.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/environmentalAndAcuteInjuries/environmentalAndAcuteInjuries.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Temperature, substances, and water exposure can rapidly worsen an individual's condition and demand hazard-specific first aid.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come reagire in modo più sicuro a ustioni, esposizioni pericolose, emergenze termiche e annegamento.

##### Primo soccorso in caso di esposizione chimica

[firstAidForChemicalExposure.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/environmentalAndAcuteInjuries/skills/firstAidForChemicalExposure.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Prioritize rescuer protection, interruption of exposure when safe and appropriate professional or poison-service instructions for skin, eye or inhalation contact; avoid improvised neutralization or hazardous handling.

**User-friendly description (it):** Proteggiti e cerca indicazioni specifiche dopo l'esposizione a una sostanza chimica nociva.

##### Primo soccorso per le ustioni termiche

[firstAidForThermalBurns.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/environmentalAndAcuteInjuries/skills/firstAidForThermalBurns.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** End thermal exposure when safe, cool a heat burn appropriately and recognize features that require urgent medical assessment; chemical injuries require different hazard-specific precautions.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi il raffreddamento iniziale delle ustioni termiche e quando è necessario richiedere assistenza.

##### Prestare primo soccorso dopo un annegamento

[provideFirstAidAfterDrowning.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/environmentalAndAcuteInjuries/skills/provideFirstAidAfterDrowning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the special urgency of impaired breathing after submersion, arrange emergency response and apply appropriate current resuscitation and monitoring guidance within training; do not delay vital assistance for nonessential actions.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci i rischi respiratori urgenti dopo un episodio di annegamento e la necessità di soccorsi immediati.

##### Reagire ai malesseri dovuti al caldo

[respondToHeatIllness.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/environmentalAndAcuteInjuries/skills/respondToHeatIllness.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish concerning heat-related symptoms and prioritize safe cooling and escalation for severe illness.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci le gravi malattie da calore e la necessità di raffreddamento e assistenza urgente.

##### Reagire all'ipotermia

[respondToHypothermia.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/environmentalAndAcuteInjuries/skills/respondToHypothermia.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Limit further cooling, handle an affected person carefully, and recognize that severe cold exposure needs urgent assessment.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riduci ulteriori perdite di calore e richiedi una valutazione dopo un'esposizione pericolosa al freddo.

#### Valutazione iniziale e richiesta di aiuto

Skills: 4

[initialAssessmentAndHelp.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/initialAssessmentAndHelp/initialAssessmentAndHelp.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Initial response begins with rescuer safety, recognition of urgent changes in responsiveness or breathing, and continued observation. Calling for help uses the shared competency in Emergencies and Civil Protection rather than a duplicate Skill.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri i primi passi per valutare una persona che potrebbe aver bisogno di soccorso urgente.

##### Valutare la respirazione

[assessBreathing.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/initialAssessmentAndHelp/skills/assessBreathing.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize absent or abnormal breathing as a medical emergency without delaying the call for help.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci una respirazione anomala o assente che richiede un intervento d'emergenza.

##### Valutare la reattività

[assessResponsiveness.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/initialAssessmentAndHelp/skills/assessResponsiveness.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Check whether a person responds and recognize when reduced responsiveness requires immediate escalation.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci quando una persona non risponde normalmente agli stimoli.

##### Valutare la sicurezza della scena prima di intervenire

[assessSceneSafetyBeforeHelping.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/initialAssessmentAndHelp/skills/assessSceneSafetyBeforeHelping.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify traffic, fire, electricity, violence, contamination, or unstable surroundings before approaching an affected person.

**User-friendly description (it):** Verifica se avvicinarti a una persona ferita potrebbe metterti in pericolo.

##### Assistere una persona incosciente che respira normalmente

[careForAnUnresponsivePersonWhoIsBreathingNormally.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/initialAssessmentAndHelp/skills/careForAnUnresponsivePersonWhoIsBreathingNormally.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Provide appropriate positioning and continuous monitoring while arranging urgent help for an unresponsive person who breathes normally; account for possible trauma and avoid unnecessary movement.

**User-friendly description (it):** Aiuta una persona che non risponde ma respira, sorvegliandola mentre attendi i soccorsi.

#### Emergenze mediche

Skills: 8

[medicalEmergencies.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/medicalEmergencies/medicalEmergencies.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Prompt recognition and appropriate escalation are more important than attempting diagnosis or administering unfamiliar medication.

**User-friendly description (it):** Impara a riconoscere i segnali d'allarme che richiedono un rapido intervento sanitario.

##### Riconoscere i segni di un infarto

[recognizeSignsOfAHeartAttack.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/medicalEmergencies/skills/recognizeSignsOfAHeartAttack.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify concerning chest discomfort and associated symptoms as possible medical emergencies requiring timely assistance.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci i sintomi che potrebbero indicare un infarto.

##### Riconoscere i segni di un ictus

[recognizeSignsOfStroke.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/medicalEmergencies/skills/recognizeSignsOfStroke.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use sudden neurological changes as reasons for urgent emergency response, even if symptoms appear to improve.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci i sintomi improvvisi che potrebbero indicare un ictus.

##### Intervenire durante una crisi convulsiva

[respondToSeizures.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/medicalEmergencies/skills/respondToSeizures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Protect the person from surrounding injury, avoid harmful restraint, and recognize conditions requiring urgent assistance.

**User-friendly description (it):** Proteggi la persona durante una crisi convulsiva senza immobilizzarla.

##### Reagire a una grave reazione allergica

[respondToSevereAllergicReaction.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/medicalEmergencies/skills/respondToSevereAllergicReaction.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize possible anaphylaxis and the need for rapid emergency help and appropriate trained use of prescribed rescue medication.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci una reazione allergica grave come un'emergenza che richiede cure tempestive.

##### Reagire a una grave difficoltà respiratoria

[respondToSevereBreathingDifficulty.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/medicalEmergencies/skills/respondToSevereBreathingDifficulty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize major difficulty breathing, severe respiratory distress or rapidly worsening symptoms as reasons to activate emergency assistance and support a safe position while awaiting qualified care.

**User-friendly description (it):** Richiedi assistenza urgente in caso di problemi respiratori gravi o in peggioramento.

##### Reagire a una sospetta ipoglicemia

[respondToSuspectedHypoglycaemia.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/medicalEmergencies/skills/respondToSuspectedHypoglycaemia.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize possible low blood glucose and distinguish safe assistance for a person who is fully alert and can swallow from the need for urgent help when consciousness or swallowing is impaired.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci una possibile glicemia troppo bassa e quando la difficoltà a deglutire rende pericoloso intervenire per bocca.

##### Reagire a una sospetta overdose di oppioidi

[respondToSuspectedOpioidOverdose.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/medicalEmergencies/skills/respondToSuspectedOpioidOverdose.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize dangerous respiratory depression or unresponsiveness following possible opioid exposure, activate emergency services and understand the role of naloxone and basic life support where available and within training.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci una possibile overdose di oppioidi e la necessità di soccorsi d'emergenza e naloxone.

##### Reagire a un sospetto avvelenamento

[respondToSuspectedPoisoning.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/medicalEmergencies/skills/respondToSuspectedPoisoning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify possible toxic exposures, prevent further exposure without risking the helper and seek poison-service or emergency guidance; do not induce vomiting or improvise remedies. Opioid-specific response is addressed separately.

**User-friendly description (it):** Chiedi indicazioni a un centro antiveleni o ai servizi di emergenza invece di improvvisare rimedi.

### Alfabetizzazione sanitaria e assistenza

Groups: 3 · Skills: 12

[healthLiteracyAndCare.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/healthLiteracyAndCare.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Personal health decisions rely on interpreting bodily changes, credible evidence, and the division of responsibility between self-care and professional services. This domain concerns informed choices and access to care rather than the biological mechanisms of disease.

**User-friendly description (it):** Impara a riconoscere i cambiamenti della salute, usare informazioni affidabili e cercare assistenza adeguata.

#### Salute e rischi

Skills: 5

[healthAndRisk.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/healthAndRisk/healthAndRisk.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Health depends on interacting physical, psychological, social, and environmental conditions. Risk factors affect probability rather than determining an individual's diagnosis.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora come condizioni e scelte diverse possono influire sui rischi per la salute.

##### Valutare un rischio per la salute

[assessHealthRelatedRisk.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/healthAndRisk/skills/assessHealthRelatedRisk.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate the likelihood and potential consequences of longer-term health outcomes arising from exposures, behaviours or protective measures, accounting for uncertainty without converting population-level estimates into diagnoses.

**User-friendly description (it):** Considera la probabilità e i possibili effetti di un rischio per la salute.

##### Scegliere misure preventive per la salute

[choosePreventiveHealthMeasures.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/healthAndRisk/skills/choosePreventiveHealthMeasures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Match health risks to evidence-based prevention such as vaccination, screening advice or protective daily habits, distinguishing the prevention of illness from first aid, clinical treatment and general accident avoidance.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scegli misure preventive appropriate sulla base di evidenze sanitarie affidabili.

##### Individuare i fattori che influiscono sulla salute

[identifyFactorsAffectingHealth.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/healthAndRisk/skills/identifyFactorsAffectingHealth.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect habits, exposures, living conditions, heredity, and access to services with health outcomes while avoiding simplistic one-cause explanations.

**User-friendly description (it):** Individua come abitudini e ambienti, insieme ad altri fattori, influiscono sulla salute.

##### Interpretare le misurazioni sanitarie di base

[interpretBasicHealthMeasurements.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/healthAndRisk/skills/interpretBasicHealthMeasurements.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate observations such as temperature, pulse, or blood pressure to measurement conditions and reference context without making a diagnosis from one reading.

**User-friendly description (it):** Interpreta i valori sanitari di base senza considerare un singolo risultato come una diagnosi.

##### Riconoscere i cambiamenti nello stato di salute

[recognizeChangesInHealthStatus.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/healthAndRisk/skills/recognizeChangesInHealthStatus.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish a usual bodily variation from a new or worsening change that deserves monitoring or advice, without treating a single symptom as a definitive diagnosis.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci quando un nuovo cambiamento corporeo merita attenzione o un parere professionale.

#### Informazioni sanitarie e medicinali

Skills: 3

[healthInformationAndMedicines.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/healthInformationAndMedicines/healthInformationAndMedicines.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Claims about prevention and treatment should be evaluated against trustworthy evidence, and medicines require label-aware, safe handling; clinical observations and basic measurements are classified in Health and Risk.

**User-friendly description (it):** Impara a valutare i consigli sulla salute e a utilizzare i medicinali in sicurezza.

##### Valutare le fonti di informazioni sanitarie

[evaluateHealthInformationSources.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/healthInformationAndMedicines/skills/evaluateHealthInformationSources.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess provenance, professional consensus, supporting evidence, conflicts of interest, and publication context rather than relying on popularity or testimonials.

**User-friendly description (it):** Verifica se i consigli sanitari provengono da fonti credibili e basate su prove scientifiche.

##### Riconoscere affermazioni sanitarie ingannevoli

[recognizeMisleadingHealthClaims.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/healthInformationAndMedicines/skills/recognizeMisleadingHealthClaims.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify miracle-cure promises, unsupported causal claims, and advertising disguised as medical advice, including claims about supplements.

**User-friendly description (it):** Individua le cure miracolose prive di prove e la pubblicità medica fuorviante.

##### Utilizzare i medicinali in sicurezza

[useMedicinesSafely.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/healthInformationAndMedicines/skills/useMedicinesSafely.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Respect intended use, dosing instructions, contraindications, storage, expiry, and professional guidance; avoid sharing prescription medicine or guessing a dose.

**User-friendly description (it):** Segui le indicazioni sui medicinali ed evita di condividerli o improvvisarne le dosi.

#### Utilizzo dei servizi sanitari

Skills: 4

[usingHealthcare.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/usingHealthcare/usingHealthcare.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Seeking care effectively includes choosing an appropriate service, describing a concern, understanding an agreed plan, and knowing when assistance is urgent.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come accedere alle cure e collaborare con i professionisti sanitari.

##### Scegliere il livello di assistenza sanitaria adeguato

[chooseAnAppropriateLevelOfHealthcare.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/usingHealthcare/skills/chooseAnAppropriateLevelOfHealthcare.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish routine consultation, timely professional assessment, and urgent emergency response by the nature and progression of symptoms.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci quando un problema richiede una visita ordinaria oppure un intervento urgente.

##### Comunicare i sintomi a un professionista sanitario

[communicateSymptomsToAClinician.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/usingHealthcare/skills/communicateSymptomsToAClinician.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Convey onset, duration, relevant changes, treatments already taken, and questions without substituting an assumed diagnosis for observations.

**User-friendly description (it):** Descrivi chiaramente i sintomi e quando si sono manifestati a un professionista sanitario.

##### Partecipare a decisioni sanitarie informate

[participateInInformedHealthcareDecisions.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/usingHealthcare/skills/participateInInformedHealthcareDecisions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the roles of understandable information, consent, alternatives, privacy, and the right to ask questions in clinical encounters.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora il consenso, la riservatezza e il tuo diritto di fare domande durante l'assistenza sanitaria.

##### Comprendere un piano di cura

[understandACarePlan.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/usingHealthcare/skills/understandACarePlan.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the purpose, timing, follow-up, and precautions of a clinician's instructions and clarify uncertainty before acting.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi lo scopo, i tempi e le precauzioni di un piano di cura concordato.

### Igiene e prevenzione delle infezioni

Groups: 3 · Skills: 12

[hygieneAndInfectionPrevention.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Disease prevention includes reducing contact with infectious agents and maintaining sanitary conditions. This domain concerns personal and environmental prevention, not microbiological taxonomy or clinical infection treatment.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora modi pratici per ridurre le infezioni attraverso l'igiene e ambienti più sicuri.

#### Igiene personale

Skills: 4

[personalHygiene.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/personalHygiene/personalHygiene.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Effective routines reflect how contamination spreads between hands, body surfaces, shared objects, and everyday environments.

**User-friendly description (it):** Sviluppa abitudini utili per limitare la contaminazione delle mani e degli oggetti quotidiani.

##### Igiene del corpo

[bodyHygiene.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/personalHygiene/skills/bodyHygiene.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Select suitable cleaning and personal-care routines for skin, hair, and intimate areas without assuming excessive washing is beneficial.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scegli abitudini adeguate per prenderti cura della pelle e del corpo.

##### Igiene delle mani

[handHygiene.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/personalHygiene/skills/handHygiene.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use washing or an appropriate hand sanitizer at meaningful moments, paying attention to coverage and the circumstances in which soap and water are needed.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci quando lavare le mani e come farlo in modo efficace.

##### Igiene degli oggetti personali

[hygieneOfPersonalItems.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/personalHygiene/skills/hygieneOfPersonalItems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reduce contamination from shared towels, grooming tools, and reusable items through appropriate individual use and cleaning.

**User-friendly description (it):** Mantieni puliti gli oggetti personali ed evita di condividere quelli che potrebbero diffondere infezioni.

##### Igiene orale

[oralHygiene.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/personalHygiene/skills/oralHygiene.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Maintain teeth and gums through suitable brushing, interdental care, and preventive dental visits while recognizing that pain or bleeding may require assessment.

**User-friendly description (it):** Impara le abitudini quotidiane che aiutano a proteggere denti e gengive.

#### Ambienti igienicamente sicuri

Skills: 3

[sanitaryEnvironments.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/sanitaryEnvironments/sanitaryEnvironments.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Water, indoor air, surfaces, and sanitation infrastructure influence exposure and should be managed according to actual contamination pathways.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora come acqua, aria e superfici sicure influiscono sul rischio di infezione.

##### Pulizia e disinfezione

[cleaningAndDisinfection.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/sanitaryEnvironments/skills/cleaningAndDisinfection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish routine removal of dirt from targeted disinfection and avoid unsafe mixing or misuse of cleaning chemicals.

**User-friendly description (it):** Distingui la pulizia quotidiana dalla disinfezione mirata e dall'uso improprio delle sostanze chimiche.

##### Aria interna e ventilazione

[indoorAirAndVentilation.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/sanitaryEnvironments/skills/indoorAirAndVentilation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify circumstances in which fresh-air exchange and source control reduce airborne exposure, while accounting for outdoor hazards.

**User-friendly description (it):** Usa la ventilazione per ridurre l'esposizione negli ambienti chiusi, considerando anche i pericoli esterni.

##### Acqua potabile sicura

[safeDrinkingWater.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/sanitaryEnvironments/skills/safeDrinkingWater.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish potable from potentially contaminated supplies and recognize when verified treatment or an alternative source is required.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci quando una fonte d'acqua potrebbe non essere sicura da bere.

#### Trasmissione e protezione

Skills: 5

[transmissionAndProtection.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/transmissionAndProtection/transmissionAndProtection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infectious hazards can spread through different routes and require measures suited to the agent and environment, not one universal precaution.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come si diffondono le infezioni e quali precauzioni sono adatte a ciascuna via di trasmissione.

##### Riconoscere le vie di trasmissione delle infezioni

[recognizeInfectionTransmissionRoutes.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/transmissionAndProtection/skills/recognizeInfectionTransmissionRoutes.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish respiratory, contact, foodborne, bloodborne, and vector-related exposure when considering prevention.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci la trasmissione per contatto, respiratoria, alimentare e attraverso altre vie.

##### Igiene respiratoria

[respiratoryHygiene.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/transmissionAndProtection/skills/respiratoryHygiene.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reduce exposure when coughing, sneezing, or experiencing respiratory symptoms using appropriate etiquette, ventilation, and context-specific precautions.

**User-friendly description (it):** Adotta precauzioni appropriate per la tosse, la ventilazione e la presenza di malattie.

##### Reagire ai segni di una malattia infettiva

[respondToSignsOfInfectiousIllness.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/transmissionAndProtection/skills/respondToSignsOfInfectiousIllness.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Decide when to rest, reduce exposure to others, monitor worsening symptoms, and seek professional advice rather than relying solely on home care.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci quando una malattia richiede di ridurre i contatti o chiedere un parere medico.

##### Contatto sicuro con sangue e fluidi corporei

[safeContactWithBloodAndBodyFluids.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/transmissionAndProtection/skills/safeContactWithBloodAndBodyFluids.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Avoid direct unprotected exposure and understand when barriers, handwashing, and professional assistance are necessary.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi perché il contatto con sangue e fluidi corporei richiede misure di protezione.

##### Conoscere la vaccinazione

[vaccinationLiteracy.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/transmissionAndProtection/skills/vaccinationLiteracy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish how immunization reduces specified disease risks from claims of absolute protection and recognize the role of recommended schedules.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi contro quali rischi la vaccinazione può proteggere e quali limiti presenta.

### Benessere mentale e sostegno

Groups: 3 · Skills: 10

[mentalWellBeingAndSupport.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/mentalWellBeingAndSupport.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Health protection includes noticing psychological strain, choosing supportive coping strategies, and connecting people with qualified help. The psychological mechanisms of emotion and cognition belong principally to Psychology.

**User-friendly description (it):** Impara a riconoscere il disagio emotivo, chiedere sostegno e reagire alle crisi in sicurezza.

#### Strategie quotidiane di gestione e assistenza

Skills: 4

[everydayCopingAndAssistance.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/everydayCopingAndAssistance/everydayCopingAndAssistance.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Helpful responses can involve self-care, support networks, appropriate boundaries, and referral rather than demanding that a person solve a crisis alone.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri strategie quotidiane per affrontare le difficoltà e fonti di aiuto adeguate.

##### Prevenire il sovraccarico cronico

[preventChronicOverload.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/everydayCopingAndAssistance/skills/preventChronicOverload.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Notice sustained imbalance between demands and recovery and identify feasible changes or sources of support.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci quando richieste prolungate rendono necessari riposo o cambiamenti pratici.

##### Cercare sostegno per la salute mentale

[seekMentalHealthSupport.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/everydayCopingAndAssistance/skills/seekMentalHealthSupport.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify trusted people, professional services, and ways of communicating a concern, including when ordinary support is insufficient.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come contattare una persona fidata o un servizio qualificato di salute mentale.

##### Sostenere una persona in difficoltà emotiva

[supportSomeoneExperiencingDistress.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/everydayCopingAndAssistance/skills/supportSomeoneExperiencingDistress.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Listen without judgment, respect privacy, avoid diagnosing, and help the person reach appropriate assistance.

**User-friendly description (it):** Aiuta una persona ascoltandola e accompagnandola nella ricerca di assistenza adeguata.

##### Usare strategie sicure per affrontare le difficoltà

[useSafeCopingStrategies.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/everydayCopingAndAssistance/skills/useSafeCopingStrategies.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Select proportionate methods such as grounding, rest, movement, and social connection without presenting them as substitutes for necessary care.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scegli modi sicuri e proporzionati per gestire le difficoltà emotive quotidiane.

#### Crisi di salute mentale

Skills: 3

[mentalHealthCrises.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/mentalHealthCrises/mentalHealthCrises.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Immediate safety and connection to competent support take priority over attempting therapy or managing a potentially dangerous situation alone.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi perché un grave pericolo psicologico richiede assistenza immediata e competente.

##### Prestare primo soccorso psicologico

[providePsychologicalFirstAid.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/mentalHealthCrises/skills/providePsychologicalFirstAid.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Offer calm, practical, non-intrusive support, immediate needs assessment, and connection with services without forcing disclosure of traumatic experiences.

**User-friendly description (it):** Offri un aiuto pratico e calmo senza fare pressione perché la persona racconti il trauma.

##### Riconoscere una crisi psicologica acuta

[recognizeAnAcutePsychologicalCrisis.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/mentalHealthCrises/skills/recognizeAnAcutePsychologicalCrisis.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify immediate danger, severe disorientation, or expressed intent to self-harm as circumstances requiring prompt adult or professional help.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci le situazioni in cui è necessario l'aiuto immediato di un adulto o di un professionista.

##### Reagire al rischio di autolesionismo o suicidio

[respondToSelfHarmOrSuicideRisk.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/mentalHealthCrises/skills/respondToSelfHarmOrSuicideRisk.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Prioritize safety, timely emergency or crisis-service involvement, and staying within one's competence without secrecy promises.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi perché i timori di autolesionismo richiedono un sostegno tempestivo per la sicurezza.

#### Riconoscere il disagio psicologico

Skills: 3

[recognizingStrain.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/recognizingStrain/recognizingStrain.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distress varies in intensity and duration; a sign can indicate a need for support without establishing a psychiatric diagnosis.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci i cambiamenti che possono segnalare la necessità di sostegno psicologico.

##### Riconoscere strategie dannose di gestione delle difficoltà

[recognizeHarmfulCopingPatterns.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/recognizingStrain/skills/recognizeHarmfulCopingPatterns.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish restorative actions from strategies that may intensify distress or introduce additional risks.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci le abitudini con cui si affrontano le difficoltà che possono creare nuovi problemi.

##### Riconoscere i segni dello stress

[recognizeSignsOfStress.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/recognizingStrain/skills/recognizeSignsOfStress.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect changes in sleep, concentration, mood, behaviour, or bodily tension with potential overload while considering other causes.

**User-friendly description (it):** Individua i segni comuni dello stress tenendo conto anche di altre possibili cause.

##### Riconoscere i segnali di peggioramento della salute mentale

[recognizeWarningSignsOfWorseningMentalHealth.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/recognizingStrain/skills/recognizeWarningSignsOfWorseningMentalHealth.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify persistent impairment, escalating distress, or loss of usual functioning as reasons to seek suitable support.

**User-friendly description (it):** Nota le difficoltà prolungate o in peggioramento che richiedono un sostegno aggiuntivo.

### Movimento, sonno e abitudini quotidiane

Groups: 3 · Skills: 10

[movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Physical functioning benefits from feasible movement, adequate recovery, and adjustments to daily environments. This domain concerns practical health habits, not the physiology of exercise as a separate science.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora abitudini sostenibili per muoverti, recuperare le energie e svolgere comodamente le attività quotidiane.

#### Ergonomia e cura dei sensi

Skills: 3

[ergonomicsAndSensoryCare.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/ergonomicsAndSensoryCare/ergonomicsAndSensoryCare.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Workspaces and devices can be adapted to reduce strain, fatigue, and exposure rather than enforcing a single rigid body position.

**User-friendly description (it):** Impara come gli spazi di lavoro e i dispositivi possono ridurre l'affaticamento dei sensi e del corpo.

##### Adattare una postazione di lavoro ergonomica

[adaptAnErgonomicWorkspace.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/ergonomicsAndSensoryCare/skills/adaptAnErgonomicWorkspace.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Adjust screen, seat, reach, lighting, and variation of posture to a person's task and physical needs.

**User-friendly description (it):** Regola gli spazi di lavoro per raggiungere comodamente gli oggetti, avere una buona illuminazione e variare la postura.

##### Gestire l'affaticamento visivo

[manageVisualStrain.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/ergonomicsAndSensoryCare/skills/manageVisualStrain.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use suitable lighting, viewing distance, breaks, and symptom awareness during sustained near or screen work.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riduci l'affaticamento degli occhi durante la lettura prolungata e l'uso degli schermi.

##### Proteggere l'udito dal rumore

[protectHearingFromNoise.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/ergonomicsAndSensoryCare/skills/protectHearingFromNoise.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate loudness and exposure time to hearing risk, including personal listening devices and noisy environments.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci perché sia il volume sia la durata dell'ascolto influiscono sulla sicurezza dell'udito.

#### Attività fisica

Skills: 4

[physicalActivity.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/physicalActivity/physicalActivity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Activity can vary by intensity, form, and personal ability; protective choices include gradual progression and responding to warning signals.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come mantenerti attivo rispettando le tue capacità personali.

##### Pianificare un'attività fisica regolare

[planRegularPhysicalActivity.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/physicalActivity/skills/planRegularPhysicalActivity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Combine suitable types and amounts of movement with individual capacity and opportunities, rather than relying on one sport or a universal target.

**User-friendly description (it):** Pianifica attività motorie realizzabili e adatte alle tue esigenze e circostanze.

##### Prepararsi allo sforzo fisico

[prepareForPhysicalExertion.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/physicalActivity/skills/prepareForPhysicalExertion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use context-appropriate warm-up, equipment, environment checks, and gradual increases in demand.

**User-friendly description (it):** Prepara l'attrezzatura e l'ambiente circostante prima di uno sforzo fisico.

##### Prevenire le lesioni durante l'esercizio

[preventExerciseRelatedInjury.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/physicalActivity/skills/preventExerciseRelatedInjury.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Adjust technique, load, recovery, and protective measures to the activity without assuming injury is unavoidable.

**User-friendly description (it):** Impara come ridurre le lesioni evitabili durante l'attività fisica.

##### Riconoscere i segnali d'allarme durante l'attività

[recognizeWarningSignsDuringActivity.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/physicalActivity/skills/recognizeWarningSignsDuringActivity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish ordinary exertion from concerning symptoms or conditions requiring stopping, assistance, or medical assessment.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci i sintomi che indicano la necessità di interrompere un'attività.

#### Sonno e recupero

Skills: 3

[sleepAndRecovery.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/sleepAndRecovery/sleepAndRecovery.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Sleep quality is affected by timing, environment, individual needs, and habits; persistent difficulty may warrant professional attention.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora come il sonno e il riposo regolare influiscono sulle attività quotidiane.

##### Riconoscere abitudini di sonno problematiche

[recognizeProblematicSleepPatterns.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/sleepAndRecovery/skills/recognizeProblematicSleepPatterns.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Notice persistent disruption or dangerous sleepiness and distinguish a need for evaluation from an occasional poor night.

**User-friendly description (it):** Nota quando problemi persistenti del sonno meritano attenzione professionale.

##### Favorire abitudini di sonno sane

[supportHealthySleepRoutines.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/sleepAndRecovery/skills/supportHealthySleepRoutines.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify modifiable factors such as light, noise, stimulants, and schedule regularity that can affect sleep.

**User-friendly description (it):** Adatta le abitudini e l'ambiente circostante per favorire un sonno migliore.

##### Comprendere il fabbisogno di sonno

[understandSleepNeeds.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/sleepAndRecovery/skills/understandSleepNeeds.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate sufficient sleep and regular timing to functioning while accounting for differences across life stages and circumstances.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci come il fabbisogno di sonno cambia con l'età e le circostanze.

### Alimentazione e sicurezza alimentare

Groups: 3 · Skills: 13

[nutritionAndFoodSafety.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/nutritionAndFoodSafety.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Eating and drinking support health through nutrients, adequate intake, and safe preparation. Nutritional choices and microbial or chemical food hazards are distinct competencies, even though the same meal can involve both.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come una buona alimentazione e una gestione attenta del cibo favoriscono la salute.

#### Scelte alimentari e informazioni

Skills: 4

[foodChoicesAndInformation.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/foodChoicesAndInformation/foodChoicesAndInformation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Marketing, accessibility, food labels, allergies, and personal circumstances shape real-life nutritional decisions.

**User-friendly description (it):** Impara a usare le etichette e le prove disponibili per scegliere gli alimenti.

##### Adattare le scelte alimentari alle esigenze nutrizionali

[adaptFoodChoicesToDietaryNeeds.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/foodChoicesAndInformation/skills/adaptFoodChoicesToDietaryNeeds.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Select suitable alternatives for medical, nutritional, ethical or cultural dietary requirements, distinguishing individual preference from a potentially dangerous allergen exposure.

**User-friendly description (it):** Adatta le scelte alimentari a esigenze dietetiche reali e preferenze personali.

##### Interpretare le etichette alimentari

[interpretFoodLabels.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/foodChoicesAndInformation/skills/interpretFoodLabels.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use ingredient lists, nutritional information, serving quantities, and date markings without treating a marketing slogan as evidence.

**User-friendly description (it):** Leggi gli ingredienti, le porzioni e le informazioni nutrizionali degli alimenti.

##### Gestire i rischi delle allergie alimentari

[manageFoodAllergyRisks.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/foodChoicesAndInformation/skills/manageFoodAllergyRisks.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify allergens and cross-contact warnings, verify ingredients, take appropriate avoidance precautions and understand when an allergic reaction requires urgent care.

**User-friendly description (it):** Individua gli allergeni ed evita i pericolosi contatti incrociati tra ingredienti.

##### Riconoscere la disinformazione alimentare

[recognizeDietaryMisinformation.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/foodChoicesAndInformation/skills/recognizeDietaryMisinformation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish evidence-based nutritional advice from detox claims, extreme restrictions, and unsupported promises of rapid results.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci affermazioni prive di prove su diete, disintossicazioni e risultati rapidi.

#### Rischi legati agli alimenti

Skills: 5

[foodborneHazards.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/foodborneHazards/foodborneHazards.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Food safety depends on separation, temperature, handling, and storage; appearance or smell alone cannot always establish whether food is safe.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come la preparazione e la conservazione degli alimenti possono prevenire le malattie.

##### Mantenere l'igiene durante la preparazione degli alimenti

[maintainHygieneDuringFoodPreparation.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/foodborneHazards/skills/maintainHygieneDuringFoodPreparation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Maintain clean hands, utensils and work surfaces while preparing meals, limiting microbial contamination without subsuming the distinct task of keeping raw foods separate from ready-to-eat foods.

**User-friendly description (it):** Mantieni pulite le mani e le superfici della cucina mentre prepari da mangiare.

##### Prevenire la contaminazione incrociata tra alimenti crudi e pronti

[preventRawToReadyFoodCrossContamination.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/foodborneHazards/skills/preventRawToReadyFoodCrossContamination.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Keep raw animal products and their juices from contaminating ready-to-eat food through separate equipment, storage and handling; this concerns foodborne pathogens rather than allergen cross-contact.

**User-friendly description (it):** Tieni separati i prodotti animali crudi dagli alimenti pronti al consumo.

##### Riconoscere situazioni alimentari non sicure

[recognizeUnsafeFoodSituations.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/foodborneHazards/skills/recognizeUnsafeFoodSituations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify spoilage, damaged packaging, unsafe water, and uncertain storage histories while understanding that some hazards are invisible.

**User-friendly description (it):** Individua i rischi per la sicurezza alimentare anche quando il cibo sembra normale.

##### Cottura e riscaldamento sicuri degli alimenti

[safeCookingAndReheating.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/foodborneHazards/skills/safeCookingAndReheating.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate sufficient heating to reducing specified foodborne hazards rather than relying only on colour or texture.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi perché una cottura e un riscaldamento adeguati sono importanti.

##### Conservazione sicura degli alimenti

[safeFoodStorage.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/foodborneHazards/skills/safeFoodStorage.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Select appropriate storage conditions and time limits, distinguishing shelf-stable from perishable foods.

**User-friendly description (it):** Conserva gli alimenti deperibili in condizioni appropriate.

#### Fondamenti di nutrizione

Skills: 4

[nutritionalFoundations.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/nutritionalFoundations/nutritionalFoundations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Food supplies energy and essential nutrients; dietary adequacy depends on patterns over time rather than judging a single meal as healthy or unhealthy.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora l'alimentazione come insieme di scelte, non come ricerca del singolo pasto perfetto.

##### Modelli alimentari equilibrati

[balancedDietaryPatterns.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/nutritionalFoundations/skills/balancedDietaryPatterns.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider variety, food groups, nutrient adequacy, and individual needs without assuming one fixed menu fits everyone.

**User-friendly description (it):** Costruisci un'alimentazione varia e adatta alle esigenze individuali.

##### Idratazione

[hydration.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/nutritionalFoundations/skills/hydration.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize fluid needs and common signs of insufficient intake while accounting for activity, climate, and health circumstances.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi come l'attività e l'ambiente influiscono sul fabbisogno di liquidi.

##### Interpretare il bilancio energetico alimentare

[interpretDietaryEnergyBalance.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/nutritionalFoundations/skills/interpretDietaryEnergyBalance.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate energy intake to expenditure and changing individual needs while distinguishing energy balance from dietary quality and avoiding unsupported conclusions about a person's health from body size.

**User-friendly description (it):** Distingui l'energia introdotta e consumata dalla qualità complessiva dell'alimentazione.

##### Comprendere il ruolo dei nutrienti

[understandTheRolesOfNutrients.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/nutritionalFoundations/skills/understandTheRolesOfNutrients.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate macronutrients, vitamins, minerals and fibre to their major physiological roles and distinguish nutritional adequacy from the amount of food alone, without reproducing biochemical mechanisms.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci le diverse funzioni dei nutrienti e delle fibre alimentari.

### Confini personali e prevenzione della violenza

Groups: 3 · Skills: 13

[personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Safety in relationships requires bodily autonomy, recognition of coercion, and effective routes to protection. Mechanisms of social influence are studied in Psychology; here the emphasis is on avoiding harm and obtaining help.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci coercizione e violenza e scopri come proteggere la tua sicurezza e i tuoi confini personali.

#### Autonomia corporea e consenso

Skills: 3

[bodilyAutonomyAndConsent.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/bodilyAutonomyAndConsent/bodilyAutonomyAndConsent.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Personal space, privacy, and permission govern respectful contact; consent must not be inferred from silence, fear, or power imbalance.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi il consenso, la riservatezza e il diritto di decidere che cosa accade al tuo corpo.

##### Comunicare un rifiuto e i propri limiti

[communicateRefusalAndLimits.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/bodilyAutonomyAndConsent/skills/communicateRefusalAndLimits.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** State a boundary or leave an unsafe interaction in a way that prioritizes personal safety over politeness.

**User-friendly description (it):** Di' di no o allontanati da un contatto non sicuro senza mettere la cortesia prima della sicurezza.

##### Riconoscere i confini personali

[recognizePersonalBoundaries.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/bodilyAutonomyAndConsent/skills/recognizePersonalBoundaries.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish acceptable from unwanted contact and intrusion into personal space, possessions, or sensitive information.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci quando un contatto o una condivisione viola i confini personali di qualcuno.

##### Riconoscere un consenso valido

[recognizeValidConsent.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/bodilyAutonomyAndConsent/skills/recognizeValidConsent.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish voluntary, informed, specific, and reversible permission from pressure or absence of resistance.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi che un consenso autentico deve essere libero, informato e revocabile.

#### Pressione e manipolazione

Skills: 4

[pressureAndManipulation.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/pressureAndManipulation/pressureAndManipulation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Coercion can use threats, secrecy, guilt, status, dependency, or urgency; a protective response need not persuade the aggressor.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come la coercizione può sfruttare il senso di colpa, le minacce o la segretezza anziché una scelta libera.

##### Riconoscere l'adescamento e lo sfruttamento

[recognizeGroomingAndExploitation.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/pressureAndManipulation/skills/recognizeGroomingAndExploitation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify boundary testing, forced secrecy, rewards, and escalating requests as possible patterns of exploitation without blaming the targeted person.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci segretezza e richieste sempre più insistenti che possono segnalare uno sfruttamento.

##### Riconoscere la pressione psicologica

[recognizePsychologicalPressure.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/pressureAndManipulation/skills/recognizePsychologicalPressure.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify demands reinforced by guilt, intimidation, isolation, or threatened consequences rather than genuine choice.

**User-friendly description (it):** Individua le pressioni basate su intimidazione, isolamento o minacce di punizione.

##### Resistere alle pressioni pericolose dei coetanei

[resistUnsafePeerPressure.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/pressureAndManipulation/skills/resistUnsafePeerPressure.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use refusal, disengagement, and supportive allies when a group promotes hazardous or humiliating behaviour.

**User-friendly description (it):** Trova modi sicuri per rifiutare richieste dannose provenienti dai coetanei.

##### Stabilire confini nelle relazioni asimmetriche

[setBoundariesInUnequalRelationships.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/pressureAndManipulation/skills/setBoundariesInUnequalRelationships.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Account for authority, dependency, age, or financial power when judging whether a demand or apparent agreement is free.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi come l'autorità o la dipendenza possono compromettere un consenso solo apparente.

#### Violenza e protezione

Skills: 6

[violenceAndProtection.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/violenceAndProtection/violenceAndProtection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Violence can be physical, psychological, sexual, economic, or digital; protection and reporting should avoid exposing affected people to retaliation.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci i comportamenti dannosi e impara come cercare protezione.

##### Riconoscere il bullismo

[recognizeBullying.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/violenceAndProtection/skills/recognizeBullying.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify a pattern of harmful repeated conduct involving a power imbalance, distinguishing bullying from a mutual disagreement or an isolated conflict.

**User-friendly description (it):** Distingui il bullismo ripetuto, caratterizzato da uno squilibrio di potere, dai conflitti comuni.

##### Riconoscere la violenza domestica e sessuale

[recognizeDomesticAndSexualViolence.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/violenceAndProtection/skills/recognizeDomesticAndSexualViolence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify controlling, threatening, non-consensual, or abusive behaviour, including harm by familiar or trusted people.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci come violenza i comportamenti di controllo, minaccia o privi di consenso.

##### Riconoscere le molestie

[recognizeHarassment.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/violenceAndProtection/skills/recognizeHarassment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify intimidating, degrading, discriminatory or otherwise unwanted targeted conduct, which may be serious even without a repeated bullying pattern.

**User-friendly description (it):** Individua le molestie che possono provocare danni anche quando non si ripetono.

##### Reagire al bullismo in sicurezza

[respondSafelyToBullying.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/violenceAndProtection/skills/respondSafelyToBullying.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Prioritize disengagement, trusted assistance, and reporting channels over retaliation or direct confrontation with aggressors.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scegli di chiedere aiuto e segnalare in sicurezza, invece di vendicarti.

##### Cercare protezione dopo una violenza

[seekProtectionAfterViolence.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/violenceAndProtection/skills/seekProtectionAfterViolence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify safe contacts, support organizations, emergency services, and appropriate documentation without requiring disclosure to an unsafe person.

**User-friendly description (it):** Individua persone e servizi sicuri da contattare dopo aver subito violenza.

##### Sostenere una persona che ha subito violenza

[supportAPersonAffectedByViolence.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/violenceAndProtection/skills/supportAPersonAffectedByViolence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Respond without blame, respect the person's choices and immediate safety, and facilitate qualified support rather than investigating the incident.

**User-friendly description (it):** Sostieni una persona colpita dalla violenza senza colpevolizzarla né condurre indagini pericolose.

### Salute sessuale e riproduttiva

Groups: 2 · Skills: 7

[sexualAndReproductiveHealth.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/sexualAndReproductiveHealth/sexualAndReproductiveHealth.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Practical knowledge about bodily development, sexual health, prevention, and access to services supports informed and safe choices. Anatomy and reproductive mechanisms are mainly Biology; moral evaluation is not substituted for factual health information.

**User-friendly description (it):** Impara informazioni attendibili sullo sviluppo, la salute riproduttiva e l'assistenza disponibile.

#### Sviluppo e cura del corpo

Skills: 3

[developmentAndBodilyCare.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/sexualAndReproductiveHealth/developmentAndBodilyCare/developmentAndBodilyCare.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Changes through puberty differ in timing and expression; normal variation and symptoms needing assessment should not be conflated.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora i cambiamenti del corpo durante la pubertà e le forme appropriate di cura personale.

##### Gestire la salute mestruale

[manageMenstrualHealth.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/sexualAndReproductiveHealth/developmentAndBodilyCare/skills/manageMenstrualHealth.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Understand menstrual variation, choose appropriate hygiene and comfort measures, track relevant changes and recognize symptoms that merit clinical attention without shame or unsupported assumptions.

**User-friendly description (it):** Gestisci le mestruazioni con un'igiene adeguata, prestando attenzione ai sintomi preoccupanti.

##### Riconoscere problemi di salute riproduttiva

[recognizeReproductiveHealthConcerns.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/sexualAndReproductiveHealth/developmentAndBodilyCare/skills/recognizeReproductiveHealthConcerns.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Notice pain, abnormal symptoms, or other changes that may require confidential professional consultation without self-diagnosis.

**User-friendly description (it):** Individua cambiamenti della salute riproduttiva che meritano un parere professionale riservato.

##### Comprendere i cambiamenti della pubertà

[understandPubertalChanges.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/sexualAndReproductiveHealth/developmentAndBodilyCare/skills/understandPubertalChanges.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish common physical changes and variations in timing from unsupported claims about a single correct developmental pattern.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci le comuni differenze nei tempi e nelle caratteristiche dei cambiamenti puberali.

#### Assistenza sanitaria sessuale e riproduttiva

Skills: 4

[sexualAndReproductiveHealthcare.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/sexualAndReproductiveHealth/sexualAndReproductiveHealthcare/sexualAndReproductiveHealthcare.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Risk reduction and access to care include prevention of sexually transmitted infections, contraception, pregnancy-related care and confidential advice. These are health-service competencies, not a prescribed set of personal choices.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi le opzioni sanitarie per la prevenzione, la gravidanza e la salute sessuale.

##### Prevenire le infezioni sessualmente trasmissibili

[preventSexuallyTransmittedInfections.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/sexualAndReproductiveHealth/sexualAndReproductiveHealthcare/skills/preventSexuallyTransmittedInfections.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish routes of transmission and evidence-based protective methods, testing, and vaccination where relevant.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci i modi per ridurre il rischio di infezioni sessualmente trasmissibili.

##### Cercare consulenza riservata sulla salute sessuale

[seekConfidentialSexualHealthAdvice.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/sexualAndReproductiveHealth/sexualAndReproductiveHealthcare/skills/seekConfidentialSexualHealthAdvice.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify appropriate services and questions about privacy, safeguarding, consent, and access to care.

**User-friendly description (it):** Trova servizi adeguati per porre domande riservate sulla salute riproduttiva.

##### Comprendere la contraccezione

[understandContraception.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/sexualAndReproductiveHealth/sexualAndReproductiveHealthcare/skills/understandContraception.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare major methods by intended function, limitations, access considerations, and need for appropriate professional advice.

**User-friendly description (it):** Confronta le funzioni e i limiti dei principali metodi contraccettivi.

##### Comprendere l'assistenza sanitaria in gravidanza

[understandPregnancyRelatedHealthcare.data.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/sexualAndReproductiveHealth/sexualAndReproductiveHealthcare/skills/understandPregnancyRelatedHealthcare.data.ts)
